title: Verify shared machine approval separately
text: Machines and the selected-code route share the pending list and approval card in source, including identity, local expiry, outcomes and return-to-terminal guidance. Authorized consumer and zero-pending evidence cleared source retirement of the hosted Inbox mirror. Historical decision rows remain readable without actions or storage changes. Standalone hosted beta, organization creation and source captures do not prove real admission. Deployed proof must preserve local reachability and the person's approval authority; the separate admission journey campaign remains owed.
